summary: Kontoor Brands filed an 8-K on July 24, 2026, covering two items: the appointment of Thomas E. Waldron as a new director (Item 5.02) and the declaration of a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.53 per share payable September 18, 2026 (Item 8.01). The board increased from six to seven members; Mr. Waldron will receive standard non-employee director compensation per the 2026 proxy. There were no special arrangements or transactions related to his appointment. The dividend is a routine quarterly payment with no unusual magnitude. This filing contains no special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change.
